mapper.sql: o.id, o.display_date, o.created_at, i.line_number AS item_line_number, i.recipe_id AS item_recipe_id, i.name AS item_name, i.image AS item_image, i.ingredients AS item_ingredients, i.instructions AS item_instructions, i.quantity AS item_quantity
mapper.select: SELECT FROM orders o LEFT JOIN order_items i ON i.order_id = o.id WHERE o.id = #{id} AND o.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY i.line_number
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO order_items (order_id, line_number, recipe_id, name, image, ingredients, instructions, quantity) VALUES
(#{orderId}, #{lineNumber}, #{item.recipeId}, #{item.name}, #{item.image}, #{item.ingredients}, #{item.instructions,typeHandler=cn.marketkitchen.mapper.CookingInstructionsTypeHandler}, #{item.quantity})
